The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the CBSE Class 10th Result 2026 today, April 15. Students who appeared for the board examinations can access their scorecards on the official website, cbseresults.nic.in, as well as through the DigiLocker and UMANG platforms. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Live: No toppers list to be released The Central Board of Secondary Education has continued its policy of not releasing a toppers list for Class 10 board exams. Since 2020, CBSE has avoided publishing merit lists to discourage unhealthy competition among students and promote a more balanced academic environment. Students will instead be able to view their individual scores and performance through official platforms, without any public ranking or topper announcements. cbseresults.nic.in Class 10 Result 2026: Last year's region-wise performance In the previous academic year, the Class 10 results declared by the Central Board of Secondary Education showed a slight improvement in overall performance. The overall pass percentage stood at 93.66%, marginally higher than 93.60% in 2024. Among regions, Thiruvananthapuram and Vijayawada emerged as the top performers, both recording an impressive 99.79% pass percentage. In terms of gender-wise performance, girls outperformed boys once again, with a 95% pass rate, compared to 92.63% among boys. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Live: What are the passing marks? Students appearing for the Class 10 board exams must secure a minimum of 33% marks to be declared pass, as per the criteria set by the Central Board of Secondary Education. Candidates who do not achieve the required 33% in one or more subjects will be given another opportunity through compartment (supplementary) examinations, allowing them to improve their scores without losing an academic year. Students are advised to carefully check their subject-wise marks once the results are declared and plan their next steps accordingly.
